label: FP
reason: User input from cookies flows to bar via doSomething, which unconditionally overwrites bar with the constant "safe!" before returning it. The returned constant is then used in the HTML output (XSS sink), but since it contains no user-controlled data, there is no actual cross-site scripting vulnerability on this path.

evidence.note: doSomething sets bar="safe!" immediately after putting param in map, effectively discarding user input.
